title: cienfuegosia drummondii var. genuina
intro: Cienfuegosia drummondii var. genuina, commonly known as Drummond's cienfuegosia or Drummond's firebush, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a flowering shrub known for its vibrant red, orange, or yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant's health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Cienfuegosia drummondii var. genuina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
